players.product: Xiaomi Group consumer ecosystem (human / car / home) expanding AI; public and enterprise cloud services buyer from Kingsoft Cloud

quarterly_data.signal: CFO Alain Lam on Q2 2026: total revenue CNY 108.9 billion, gross margin 19.8%, adjusted net profit RMB 6.2 billion. Smartphone x AIoT segment revenue CNY 84 billion at 20% gross margin; Smart EV, AI and other new initiatives revenue CNY 24.9 billion, up 17.1% YoY (23% of group revenue), with 19.2% gross margin and an operating loss of RMB 2.6 billion as investment in AI and other new initiatives increased; internet services revenue CNY 9 billion at 76.8% gross margin (up 1.4 percentage point YoY).
quarterly_data.figure: Revenue CNY 108.9 billion; adjusted net profit RMB 6.2 billion; new initiatives CNY 24.9 billion (+17.1% YoY)

quarterly_data.signal: Smartphones (CFO Lam, President William Lu): revenue CNY 42.1 billion (38.7% of total) on 31.2 million global shipments, down YoY, at a record-high ASP after product-mix optimization and price increases - Lu: ASP rose by almost CNY 300; smartphone gross margin 8.5% in Q2 (9.3% in the first half) despite historically high memory costs. Top three globally for the 24th consecutive quarter (Omdia data), top three in 53 countries and regions and top five in 67; second in Southeast Asia, Latin America and Middle East (19.3%, 16.2% and 13.5% share) and third in Europe and Africa (16.5% and 10.9%); premium smartphones 32.1% of mainland China smartphone sales, a record (third-party data). The Redmi flagship launch was advanced from October to August; Lu: more than 62% of its sales were '16 plus', ASP CNY 5,000 odd, sales up 60% versus the last generation.
quarterly_data.figure: Smartphone revenue CNY 42.1 billion; 31.2 million units; gross margin 8.5%

quarterly_data.signal: President Lu on memory costs: increases in Q4 last year and Q1-Q2 this year exceeded Xiaomi's expectations ('The cost increase was indeed alarming'); Xiaomi cannot pass the whole increase to consumers, so it is rationalizing product lines, adjusting product mix and sales strategy; entry-level phones take the biggest blow - at Q2 memory costs, retail prices over CNY 1,500 are affected and an entry-level product has to be sold at CNY 2,000. Management expects memory cost increases to continue into Q3 and Q4 but as a slowing process, and calls the smartphone business 'controllable'. Management: memory cost is now five times the Q2 last-year level but it is difficult to stay at five times for a long time; it expects smartphone pricing to reach a global equilibrium after dynamic adjustment. CFO Lam: raw-material inventory rose from almost CNY 30 billion last quarter to about CNY 40 odd billion in Q2, reflecting strategic memory stocking and rising memory unit prices.
quarterly_data.figure: memory cost five times the Q2 last-year level; raw-material inventory about CNY 40 odd billion (from almost CNY 30 billion)

quarterly_data.signal: Smart EVs: Xiaomi delivered 104,199 vehicles in Q2 2026, the sixth consecutive quarter of YoY delivery growth, with Smart EV sales revenue of CNY 23.9 billion; SU7 series ranked first in first-half sales among pure electric sedans priced above CNY 200,000 in mainland China, and cumulative SU7-series deliveries exceeded 500,000 units as of August 17, 2026. CFO Lam: segment gross margin moved on mix - last year's Q2 had higher-margin SU7 Ultra deliveries, the new-generation SU7 (launched in March) has higher costs and a larger delivery share lowered gross margin QoQ, and starting large-model revenue had a negative impact; EV ASP is a result of product mix, not a goal. Self-developed Xiaomi Titan Alloy 2.0 is mass-produced and applied to the new-generation SU7 and YU7 series.
quarterly_data.figure: 104,199 vehicles delivered; Smart EV revenue CNY 23.9 billion; SU7 cumulative deliveries over 500,000

quarterly_data.signal: EV pipeline: in July 2026 Xiaomi released its first extended-range vehicle architecture (Xiaomi Kunlun) and the SkyNomad extended-range SUVs N90 Max and N70 Max at presale prices of CNY 299,900 and CNY 259,900; official launch in September, final price not yet set (it will drive SkyNomad gross margin in Q3 and Q4). President Lu: SkyNomad targets family buyers focused on space, with very small overlap with SU7 buyers, and management is optimistic on orders. Xiaomi EVs will go overseas in the second half of 2027; management says at least 7 to 8 of the top 10 dealers in the countries it visited approached Xiaomi on their own initiative.
quarterly_data.figure: SkyNomad presale CNY 299,900 / CNY 259,900; launch September; overseas EV second half of 2027

quarterly_data.signal: AI (President Lu and management): Xiaomi released the MiMo V2.5 series in April 2026; per a CCTV report on OpenRouter's weekly global ranking, MiMo V2.5 topped the list, its call volume rising more than six-fold from 1.5 trillion to 10.5 trillion in two months, and the whole series is open source. Xiaomi released open-source MiMo Code, Xiaomi MiMo Claw (partnering with Kingsoft's office ecosystem on a document office-efficiency solution) and open-source Xiaomi Miloco 2.0 whole-house smart AI. API calls and the token plan began contributing revenue this quarter, reported within the CNY 1 billion other related business revenue (may be disclosed separately at an appropriate time). Management: AI is in a large-scale investment phase and monetization is not the primary goal; a new model is being trained and a first MiMo desktop application is coming. HyperOS 4 integrates MiMo into the OS, and Super XiaoAi 2.0 expert mode launched a points-based subscription (1,000 free points per month, plans from CNY 19 monthly).
quarterly_data.figure: call volume 1.5 trillion to 10.5 trillion in two months; other related business revenue CNY 1 billion

quarterly_data.signal: Outlook (President Lu): for Q3, storage costs will remain high, consumer demand recovery will take time and competition will remain fierce, but short-term pressure will not change the long-term strategy; Xiaomi will keep increasing investment in hardcore technologies such as AI chips, operating system and embodied intelligence, and management has not adjusted its R&D expense plan. CFO Lam: Q2 R&D expenses RMB 9.2 billion (+18.9% YoY); first-half R&D RMB 18.2 billion (+25.6%), with AI-related investments nearly 30%; Q2 capex RMB 3.6 billion, of which innovative businesses such as Smart EVs and AI accounted for 65.8%.
quarterly_data.figure: Q2 R&D RMB 9.2 billion (+18.9%); H1 R&D RMB 18.2 billion, AI nearly 30%; Q2 capex RMB 3.6 billion

quarterly_data.signal: IoT and internet: IoT revenue CNY 31.3 billion (gross margin 20.1%), down YoY on last year's national-subsidy base while overseas revenue rose significantly; more than 640 new overseas retail stores opened as of June 30 (President Lu: 630 odd overseas Mi Home stores, with expansion continuing next year); large home appliances will begin to fully enter Europe, with overseas acceleration in the second half and 'very big growth' expected next year; tablets fourth globally, TWS earbuds and wearables second. Internet: June 2026 global MAUs 770 million (+4.8% YoY), mainland China 198 million (+7%); advertising developed healthily, helped by food-delivery competition.
quarterly_data.figure: IoT revenue CNY 31.3 billion; global MAUs 770 million

quarterly_data.signal: Embodied robots (President Lu): at Xiaomi's EV factory, embodied robots raised the success rate at the self-tapping threaded insert nut loading station to 98% and reached 90% on a returnable-box folding task in the final-assembly logistics area; Xiaomi released Xiaomi-Robotics-U0 and Xiaomi-Robotics-1 (pre-trained on 100,000 hours of real-world data, open-sourced August 5). Management: large-scale maturity will take a longer time, investment continues, and no specific short-term goals are set.
quarterly_data.figure: 98% nut-loading success rate; 100,000 hours of training data
